questions.question: If N = (√7 - √3)/(√7 + √3), then what is the value of N + (1/N)?
What is the simplified value of (2 + 1)(2² + 1)(2⁴ + 1)(2⁸ + 1)?
Which one among √10 + √4, √11 + √3, √7 + √7 is the smallest number?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:-**

We compare the squares of the given numbers. Since the numbers are all greater than 1, the order of the squares of sums will follow the same order as the sum.

(√10 + √4 )² = 10 + 4 + 4√10 = 14 + 4√10

(√11 + √3)² = 11 + 3 + 2√33 = 14 + 2√33

(√7 + √7)² = 7 + 7 + 2√7² = 14 + 14

Clearly, 2√33 = (√11 + √3)² = is the smallest of all.

questions.question: If 34N is divisible by 11, then what is the value of N?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:-**

For a number to be divisible by 11, the alternate sum must be a multiple of 11.

⇒ 3 - 4 + N = 11k

⇒ -1 + N = 11k

⇒ N = 11k + 1

⇒ Nₘᵢₙ@ₖ₌₀ = 1.

questions.question: P is four times as efficient as Q. P can complete a work in 45 days less than Q. If both of them work together, then in how many days the work will be completed?
questions.solution: **Given:-** P = 4 × Q P = Q - 45days **Calculation:-** Let efficiency of Q be q. ⇒ Efficiency of P = 4q. Time taken by Q = 1/q Time taken by P = 1/4q P can complete a work in 45 days less than Q ⇒ 1/4q = 1/q - 45 -3/4q = -45 q = 3/(45 × 4) = 1/60 Combined efficiency = q + 4q = 5q. Time taken by them together = 1/5q = 1/(5 × 1/60) = 12 days.

questions.question: Two inlet pipes can fill a cistern in 10 and 12 hours respectively and an outlet pipe can empty 80 gallons of water per hour. All the three pipes working together can fill the empty cistern in 20 hours. What is the capacity (in gallons) of the tank?
questions.solution: **Given:-** Two inlet pipe's time to fill a cistern = 10 hrs and 12 hrs One outlet pipe's capacity to empty cistern = 80 gallons/hr **Calculations:-** The efficiency of the outlet pipe will be considered negative. Let the capacity of the cistern be c. Efficiency of pipe A: c/10 Efficiency of pipe B: c/12 Efficiency of outlet: -80/1 Total efficiency: c/10 + c/12 - 80 = c/20 ⇒ c(1/10 + 1/12 - 1/20) = 80 ⇒ c(6 + 5 - 3)/60 = 80 ⇒ c = 80 × 60/8 = 600 gallons.

questions.question: In a match, average of runs scored by 5 players is 49. If the runs scored by four players are 75, 30, 62 and 21 respectively, then how many runs did the 5th player had scored?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Average of runs scored by 5 players = 49

Four players runs = 75, 30, 62, 21

**Calculations:-**

Let the runs scored by fifth player be f.

Average runs = total runs/no of players

⇒ (75 + 30 + 62 + 21 + f)/5 = 49

⇒ 188 + f = 49 × 5

⇒ f = 245 - 188

⇒ f = 57

∴ **5th player scored 57 runs.**

%Profit = 20

questions.question: A motorcyclist left 6(6)/(9) minutes later than the scheduled time but in order to reach its destination 21 km away in time, he had to increase his speed by 12 kh/hr form the usual speed. What is usual speed (in km/hr) of the motorcyclist?
questions.solution:
Let the original speed be x Km/hr.

Time taken = t₁ = Distance/Speed = 21/x hr

When left late by 6(6)/(9) min, time = t₂ = travel time + waiting time = 21/(x + 12) + 1/9 hr

∵ t1 = t2,

21/x = 21/(x + 12) + 1/9

⇒ 21/x - 21/(x + 12) = 1/9

⇒ (21x + 252 - 21x)/(x × (x + 12)) = 1/9

⇒ 252/(x² + 12x) = 1/9

⇒ 2268 = x² + 12x

⇒ x² + 12x - 2268 = 0

⇒ x² + 54x - 42x - 2268 = 0

⇒ x(x + 54) - 42(x + 54) = 0

⇒ (x + 54)(x - 42) = 0

x = -54 & x = 42 Km/hr

Since speed can’t be negative, the original speed is 42 Km/hr.40

questions.question: A bus starts running with the initial speed of 33 km/hr and its speed increases every hour by certain amount. If it takes 7 hours to cover a distance of 315 km, then what will be the hourly increment (in km/hr) in the speed of the bus?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The initial speed of 33 km/hr

It takes 7 hours to cover a distance of 315 km,

**Calculation:**

Initial speed = 33 km/hr

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3f4b126b02d2aba3a55124dbece4a0f573cfab6ffc4e36b07fa835e6c5aaa18.png] 

First term = 33 km

Sum, S₇ = 315 km

The common difference, d =?

Term, n = 7

Sₙ = nover2 × [2a + (n - 1)d]

⇒ 315 = 7over2[2 × 33 + (7 - 1)d]

⇒ 90 = 66 + 6d

⇒ 6d = 90 - 66 = 24

⇒ d = 4

**∴ The hourly increment in the speed of the bus is 4 km/hr.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** Let the hourly increment in the speed of the bus be x km/hr.

33 + (33 + x) + (33 + 2x) + (33 + 3x) + (33 + 4x) + (33 + 5x) + (33 + 6x) = 315

⇒ 21x + 231 = 315

⇒ 21x = 315 - 231 = 84

⇒ x = 4 km/hr

∴ The hourly increment in the speed of the bus is 4 km/hr.

questions.question: An amount was lent for two years at the rate of 20% per annum compounding annually. Had the compounding been done half yearly, the interest would have increased by 241. What was the amount (in Rs) lent?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total interest compounded annually for 2 years = 20 + 20 + [(20 × 20)/100]%

⇒ (40 + 4)%

⇒ 44%

Now, Total interest compounded half yearly for 1 year = 10 + 10 + [(10 × 10)/100]%

⇒ (20 + 1)%

⇒ 21%

Now, Total interest for 2 years = 21 + 21 + [(21 × 21)/100]%

⇒ (42 + 4.41)%

⇒ 46.41%

Difference in interest = (46.41 – 44)%

⇒ 2.41%

Now, 2.41% = Rs. 241

⇒ 100% = Rs. (241/2.41) × 100

⇒ Rs. 10,000

∴ The amount lent was Rs. 10,000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Annual C.I = P × 6over5 × 6over5 - P = 11Pover25

Half Yearly C.I,

Rate = 1over10, Time = 4 years

Half Yearly C.I = P × 11over10 × 11over10 × 11over10 × 11over10 - P = 4641Pover10000

Difference,

4641Pover10000 - 11Pover25 = 241

⇒ (4641P-4400P)over10000 = 241

⇒ 241Pover10000 = 241

⇒ P = Rs. 10000

∴ The amount lent was Rs. 10,000.

questions.question: If (p² + q²)/(r² + s²) = (pq)/(rs), then what is the value of (p - q)/(p + q) in terms of r and s?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(p2 + q2)/(r2 + s2) = (pq)/(rs)

**Calculation:**

⇒ p² + q²/pq = r² + s²/rs

We know,

(p + q)² = p² + q² + 2pq

(p - q)² = p2 + q2 - 2pq

(r + s)² = r² + s² + 2rs

(r - s)² = r2 + s2 - 2rs

⇒ [(p + q)² - 2pq]/pq = r² + s²/rs

⇒ (p + q)²/pq = (r2 + s2)/rs + 2

⇒ (p + q)² = r² + s² + 2rs/rs × pq

⇒ (p + q)² = (r + s)²/rs × pq -----------(1)

Similarly,

⇒ (p - q)² + 2pq/pq = r² + s²/rs

⇒ (p - q)²/pq = (r² + s²)/rs - 2

⇒ (p - q)2/pq = r2 + s2 - 2rs/rs

⇒ (p - q)2/pq = (r - s)²/rs

⇒ (p - q)2 = (r - s)2/rs × pq ------------(2)

On dividing eq(1) and eq(2) we get,

⇒ p + q/p - q = r + s/r -s

And on reversal,

⇒ p - q/p + q = r - s/r + s

∴ The correct answer is **r - s/r + s**.

questions.question: If the expression (px³ - 8x² - qx + 1) is completely divisible by the expression (3x²- 4x + 1), then what will be the value of p and q respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(px3 - 8x2 - qx + 1) is completely divisible by the expression (3x2- 4x + 1)

**Calculation:**

Since 3x²- 4x + 1 = (x - 1)( 3x - 1) divides the given polynomial, x = 1 and x = 1/3 should set the polynomial to 0.

⇒ p × 1³- 8 × 1²- q × 1 + 1 = 0

⇒ p - 8 - q + 1 = 0

⇒ p - q = 7

And

⇒ p × (1/3)³- 8 × (1/3)²- q × (1/3) + 1 = 0

⇒ p/27 - 8/9 - q/3 + 1 = 0

⇒ p - 24 - 9q + 27 = 0

⇒ p - 9q = -3

Subtracting the two equations, we get

9q - q = 7 + 3

8q = 10

q = 10/8 = 5/4

Substituting this in p - q = 7, we get

⇒ p - 5/4 = 7

⇒ p = 7 + 5/4 = 33/4.

∴ The correct answer is **33/4 **and **5/4**.

AB || QR

questions.question:
In the given figure, O is the center of the circle, ∠DAB = 110° and ∠BEC = 100°. What is the value (in degrees) of ∠OCB? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbe0a7d96a2516c4e62fb1c1b24fcad5a99dd5949d5df6c209e3dcf5342bb6c9.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠DAB = 110° 

∠BEC = 100° 

**Concept used:**

In cyclic quadrilateral sum of opposite angles is equal to 180°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecfac9472cf2d9342028fcdaee612aa42a3d4328985fd43c4361430d58c1fca0.png] 

The angle subtended by an arc at the center is double the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6165760f5917e3188a125a716f163b1dd7e5b44e04a79f759e89340f5e2cdc7c.png] 

**Calculation:**

Join line AC such that ACEB becomes cyclic quadrilateral.

Hence, ∠CAB = 180° - ∠BEC = 180° - 100 = 80° 

⇒ ∠BOC = 2 × ∠CAB (Angles on same chord)

⇒ 80° x 2 = 160°

In ΔBOC 

Let ∠OCB = ∠OBC = x

⇒ ∠BOC + ∠OCB + ∠OBC = 180° 

⇒ 160° + 2x = 180° 

⇒ 2x = 20° 

⇒ x = 10° 

∴ The correct answer is **10°**.

questions.question: If sec θ + cosec θ = √2 sec(90 - θ) then what is the value of cot θ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sec θ + cosec θ = √2 sec(90 - θ)

**Formula used:**

sec(90 - θ) = cosecθ 

**Calculation:**

sec θ + cosec θ = √2 sec(90 - θ) 

(sec(90 - θ) = cosec θ)

⇒sec θ + cosec θ = √2 cosec(θ)

⇒sec θ = (√2 - 1)cosec(θ)

(1/cos θ = sec θ & 1/cosec θ = sin θ)

⇒1/cos θ = (√2 - 1)/sin(θ) 

⇒cos θ/sin θ = 1/(√2 - 1)

 (cos θ/sin θ = cot θ)

⇒cot θ = 1/(√2 - 1) 

(Rationalizing the denominator) 

⇒cot θ = √2 + 1 

∴ The correct answer is **√2 + 1**.

questions.question: If sin (θ + 23°) = cos 58°, then what is the value of cos 5θ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sin(θ + 23°) = cos 58° 

**Concept used:**

If sin x = cos y,

Then, sin x = sin(90 - y)

So, x + y = 90,

Where x and y are acute.

**Calculation:**

⇒ θ + 23 + 58 = 90

⇒ θ = 90 - 23 - 58 = 9

⇒ 5θ = 45.

⇒ cos 5θ = cos 45 = 1/√2

∴ The correct answer is **1/√2**.
